# TradingView MCP

⚠️ **Trading warning / Avertissement trading** : informational only, not investment advice. Indicators describe the past, backtests are run on historical data, and a strategy that looks robust in a walk-forward window can still lose money live. Curated by Skill Harbor: the most-starred repository of the October 2026 trading scan (4,973 stars), an MCP server that gives an AI assistant a trading intelligence toolkit: live prices for stocks, crypto, ETFs, indices and FX (plus the Turkish BIST and Egyptian EGX markets), more than 30 technical indicators (RSI, MACD, Bollinger Bands, Supertrend and more), backtesting for six built-in strategies with trade logs and equity curves, a walk-forward mode that scores robustness and flags overfitting, licensed news sentiment from Marketaux, confluence analysis that combines technicals and sentiment, and multi-market screeners (bullish, oversold, exchange-specific). The repo's single SKILL.md lives under openclaw/ and is written for the OpenClaw agent harness, driving the tools through a bash wrapper script; the server itself is a standard MCP server, hosted or self-hosted, and works from Muse and other MCP clients. From the atilaahmettaner/tradingview-mcp repository (MIT). Honest caveats: prices and screener data flow from third-party endpoints that can change shape, lag or rate-limit without notice, so treat any single reading as a quote to confirm, not a fact; the sentiment layer depends on the Marketaux service; and the skill file's...
